Name: Greener Beach Farm
Author: Spikefan74
Description:
Greener Beach Farm with more grass.

Includes:
﻿- Ocean Sounds (You can take out the sounds folder if you want to hear the Vanilla music)
﻿- Recolored Beach Colors (You can take out Recolors Folder if you prefer Vanilla colors)
﻿- Tillable grass
﻿- Default is set to beach farm but you can change it to any farm type in the config file!

Changes:
﻿- Southern Cliffs have been removed
﻿- Waterfalls have been added to the north of the farmhouse.
﻿- Cliff walls along edges of map redone.

Updates:
﻿v.1.0.1. - Custom Beach Music fixed and will now play as ambient sounds on your farm when music is not playing.


Special Thanks to:

bblueberry for taking the time to help me fix my tilesheet errors!
Aubrianna Shields for helping me fix my ocean sounds!
